title: The Unknown Photographer — Evidenced Archive & Space
subtitle: Navigating between actual archival photographs, darkroom apparatus, and the spatial landscape of memory
lineage: Lineage: Loïc Sèchehay & Turab Mathieu, The Unknown Photographer (NFB, 2015)
theorem: Place authentic historical photographs and camera artifacts inside an atmospheric navigation space—fog, ruins, and darkrooms—while keeping the boundary between the evidenced photographic plate and the surrounding spatial environment unmistakable.
